The default target is this repository, so a code you hand out keeps working on someone else's machine: `assets/qr-repo.png` is that code, committed; `npm run qr` redraws it, `node scripts/share-qr.mjs --url https://your.domain/` points it elsewhere. `npm run share` serves a LAN page whose own code targets the current interface address — that is the one for handing a tarball to someone in the same room (`--lan` reproduces it on the command line). Decodability is checked against OpenCV's decoder by `scripts/verify-qr.py`: 12 boundary cases across six versions and two ECC levels, all decoded byte-identical; `--png --expect ` verifies a single image. `plugins/cn-persona/README.md` covers install, uninstall, sharing and "what it does not do". The two implementations **do not share seed semantics**: one seed gives different personas in the Python and JS versions. To line them up, pass the full profile instead. ### Distributing it | Path | Command | |---|---| | DSH plugin, from npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cn-persona` | | DSH plugin, from the release asset | `dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lirenjie95/IamChinese/releases/latest/download/dsh-cn-persona-0.1.0.tgz` | | DSH plugin, from a local tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web add .\dist\dsh-cn-persona-0.1.0.tgz` | | Claude Code, this repo as a marketplace | `claude plugin marketplace add lirenjie95/IamChinese` then `claude plugin install cn-persona@iamchinese` | | Claude Code, inside a session | `/plugin marketplace add lirenjie95/IamChinese`, then `/plugin install cn-persona@iamchinese` | | Anything else | `plugins/cn-persona/dist/` — tarball, Claude zip, `install.ps1`, `发给朋友.md`, QR | The marketplace manifest is `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` at the repository root; it points at `./plugins/cn-persona`, which carries its own `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`. With the Claude CLI installed, `claude plugin validate .` re-checks both files. Listings for the two directories live in `marketplace/`: the entry YAML for [Awesome DSH Plugin] (https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) — copied verbatim to that repo's `data/plugins/lirenjie95__IamChinese--plugin.yml`, one file is the whole submission — plus release notes and the rules to check before opening the PR. --- ## Two layers, deliberately split | Layer | Modules | Answers | Writes to the host | |---|---|---|---| | Core | `preflight` → `evaluate` → `gate` → `diagnostics` | Which region does the service think this machine is in | No, read-only throughout | | Persona | `persona` + CLI | What set of fields makes it look like a Chinese user | Only three text files | Five stages: ``` Stage 1 read-only collection → Stage 2 apply the region list → Stage 3 allow / Stage 3' explain and offer options → Stage 5 diagnostic bundle ``` Stage 1 and Stage 2 are separate (collection records facts, evaluation applies rules; each is testable alone). Stage 2 has to be computable locally; a remote list is an update, not a dependency. Stage 3' is a first-class screen, not an error dialog — the set of available buttons is computed from `reason_code

plugins.description: Glacier-blue glass UI layer for the DeepSeek Harness web client — light-field canvas, frosted panels, flat controls. Shipped as a dsh plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-glacier

给 **DeepSeek Harness（dsh）web 端**用的玻璃质感 UI 层：Antigravity 风格的蓝调画布、磨砂玻璃面板、扁平控件。以标准 dsh 插件形态分发，不改宿主一行代码。

> 状态：**v0.2.0 — 画布 + 语义色 + 侧栏/输入容器 + 对话区已实现**，冒烟 7 项全通过。剩余：空态 hero 细节、浮层（模型菜单/设置）。
> 设计定稿：`design-prototype/`（可交互原型，含 11 张验收截图）。

---

## 它做什么

| 层 | 内容 | 手段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L0 画布 | 蓝调渐变 + 三个缓慢漂移的色团 + 三条斜向光带 + 颗粒 | 自建 `.dsg-canvas` 固定层 |
| L1 语义色 | 文字 / 强调 / 边框 / 面板底色 | 覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*`（组件自动跟随） |
| L2 玻璃 | 侧栏、输入容器、气泡、代码块的磨砂质感 | CSS（低白度 + 高饱和 + 定向边缘高光 + 内部颗粒 + 投影） |
| L3 对话区 | 用户气泡、Markdown、代码块、工具卡与思考块、轮次尾巴 | CSS，锚点全部来自真实 DOM（`[data-chat-flow-kind]`、`[data-code-block-*]`、`[data-slot="tool.call.toolview"]`） |

原则：**只动视觉**。不改组件树、不重写交互、不注册 slot 组件（v0.1）。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-glacier
```

本地开发时用路径安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-glacier
```

装完刷新页面即可（前端半热生效）；卸载会恢复原样——插件的样式与画布层都在 `apply` 里可回收。

## 开发

```sh
npm run check      # 语法 + 选择器守卫 + 构建
npm run smoke      # 在真实 Chrome 里加载产物，验证注入/幂等/销毁（需本机 Chrome）
node tools/inspect-dsh.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=..."   # 抓宿主真实 DOM
```

零运行时依赖、零打包器：

```
client/index.js   ← 前端半（自包含，构建时注入 CSS）
client/*.css      ← tokens / canvas / theme / chat 四层（顺序即层叠顺序）
                    内部类前缀 dgl-（dsh-glacier layer），属性 data-dsh-glacier
src/index.js      ← 宿主半（占位，避免 boot 期副作用）
scripts/build.mjs ← 拼 CSS → 包成 window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)
```

产物：

- `client/client.js` — `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`
- `lib/index.js` — 宿主半

两者都不入库（见 `.gitignore`），`npm publish` 前由 `prepack` 生成。

## 三条硬约束（来自真实 DOM 实测）

1. **不新增全宽顶栏**。dsh 是三列布局（sidebar / center / rightbar）+ 拖拽把手，顶栏会打断它。窗口按钮走 `shell.leading`。
2. **不删空态 hero**。「探索未至之境 / 预览版 / 选择工作区 / 标准模式」是真实功能入口，只能改配色。
3. **选择器只用 `[data-slot]` / `[data-*]` / 组件名子串**（`[class*="_newSession"]`），绝不写包哈希前缀（`hHd-Xa_`）。`scripts/check-selectors.mjs` 会在 CI 里拦。

详见 [docs/structure-map.md](./docs/structure-map.md)。

## 版本策略

- 语义化版本；`0.x` 期间次版本号可能包含**选择器调整**（跟随 DSH 升级），补丁号只修样式与 bug。
- 每个版本必须写 `CHANGELOG.md`，分类 `Added / Changed / Fixed / Removed`。
- 发布前 `npm run check` 必须全绿；`npm run smoke` 建议在本地跑一遍。
- 新增 CSS 文件要登记进 `scripts/build.mjs` 的 `CSS_FILES`（顺序即层叠顺序）。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/structure-map.md](./docs/structure-map.md) | **实现前必读**：真实 DOM 骨架、191 个插槽、选择器策略、原型→真实映射、3 条必须避开的坑 |
| [docs/design-system.md](./docs/design-system.md) | 设计系统：画布配方、玻璃六件套、对比度实测、组件规格 |
| [docs/prototype-review.md](./docs/prototype-review.md) | 原型验收：截图、V01–V13、已知问题 |
| [docs/2026-10-21-dsh-web与插件市场调研.md](./docs/2026-10-21-dsh-web与插件市场调研.md) | 基础调研：插件契约、主题 API、市场机制与「兼容模式」 |
| [design-prototype/](./design-prototype) | 可交互原型（`npm run dev`） |

## 许可

MIT

![Ratel Lumina — Let interaction glow. A concept illustration of subtle motion for DeepSeek Harness.](assets/readme/hero-en.webp)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@ratel-works/dsh-lumina?logo=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ratel-works/dsh-lumina)

> **Ratel Lumina（Lumina 流光）** — a motion enhancement layer for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) client.
>
> English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Ratel Lumina adds seven visual motions to the DSH Web / PWA / desktop client. It changes **no business
logic**, carries **no runtime dependencies**, and can be switched off completely.

| # | Effect | Surface | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Brand mark & wordmark | `sidebar.brand.mark` / `sidebar.brand.name` | 1 — official slot |
| 2 | Composer edge glow | `[data-composer-card]` | 2 — CSS on a data hook |
| 3 | Streaming caret | `[data-lexical-cursor]` | 2 — CSS on a data hook |
| 4 | Button feedback & menu fade | `[data-composer-card] button` / `[data-menu-material]` | 2 — CSS on a data hook |
| 5 | New-session hero entrance | `conversation.hero.brand.mark` | 1 — official slot |
| 6 | Session activity indicator | `svg[data-state="ongoing"]` | 2 — CSS on a data hook |
| 7 | Liquid send transition | Public submission identity + corresponding user text | 2 — temporary glyph decoration |

## Visual language

The poster sets the direction: **light, not strokes**.

- Edges are thin gradients with a soft halo, never a hard outline;
- cool blue as the base, a little warm coral for the breath;
- motion reads as a band of light, never competing with content or layout;
- large editorial type, white glass, restrained negative space.

## Design principles

1. **Upgrade safety over effect count.** A missing effect is better than a patch that breaks next
   release.
2. **Degrade silently.** If a hook is renamed upstream, the effect stops — nothing breaks.
3. **Never fight interaction.** Decoration layers are `pointer-events: none`, always.
4. **Accessibility by default.** The system "reduce motion" preference is honored and cannot be
   switched off.
5. **Zero runtime dependencies.** No gsap, no three.js, no framer-motion.
6. **One switch to remove everything.** A settings toggle, one data attribute, or uninstall.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @ratel-works/dsh-lumina
```

Then restart the client — plugins are read from the manifest at startup and are not hot-reloaded.

## Status

| Stage | Scope | State |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P0 | Skeleton, loading chain, brand slot, settings page | done (19 tests) |
| MVP | Six effects + hook self-check | in progress — see [MVP](docs/product/MVP.md) |
| Next stage | ratel asset, deployment defaults, official settings card | planned |

## Repository layout

```
src/               plugin source (host half + browser half)
tests/             vitest specs, including the loading-chain proof
tools/             install and probe scripts
docs/product/      product requirements and the current MVP delivery scope
docs/engineering/  engineering plan, verified API surface, settings page design
.agents/           agent notes and the dsh-lumina-dev skill
```

## Documentation

- [Product requirements](docs/product/产品需求.md) — boundaries and long-term scope
- [MVP](docs/product/MVP.md) — current delivery scope, adaptation list, implementation order
- [Architecture](docs/engineering/架构设计.md) — layers, dependency direction, the adaptation layer
- [Technical design](docs/engineering/技术详细设计.md) — L0–L4 implementation contracts, adapter, test gates
- [Engineering plan](docs/engineering/工程规划.md)
- [Verified official API surface](docs/engineering/官方API面.md)
- [Settings page design](docs/engineering/设置页设计.md)
- [Publishing](docs/engineering/发布.md) — npm release and plugin-shop discovery
- [Motion material library](docs/reference/动效素材库.md) — reference-only sources (anime.js, GSAP, React Bits, …)

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm test
npm run install:local web
```

After a client upgrade, run `node tools/verify-hooks.mjs` in the client console to check that every
`data-*` hook the effects rely on still exists.

## Design references

Motion is built on web platform primitives — CSS transitions, keyframes, and inline SVG masks.

Several effects are **adapted from** components published on [reactbits.dev](https://reactbits.dev)
(MIT + Commons Clause). Adapted code keeps its original copyright and licence header, and every
adapted file is listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) with its source and the
licence terms that travel with it.

| Lumina effect | Adapted from |
| --- | --- |
| Brand wordmark shine | text shine / gradient text |
| Composer edge glow | border glow |
| Streaming caret | typewriter caret |
| Button feedback and menu fade | click acknowledgement |
| New-session hero | blur-to-focus entrance |

Particle and fluid cursor effects were evaluated and not adopted: they introduce a new visual entity
and require continuous frame work, which falls outside this product's scope.

## License

MIT. The reactbits study notes are **not** redistributed with this package; see
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` (Chinese) for the full licence analysis.

plugins.description: Medical literature search, citation formatting, and open-access full text for DeepSeek Harness (PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-medical-literature
项目想法来源于本人之前想做的deepresearch，好像目前没有做医学文献检索的就用deepseek改了一版适配dsh的插件。简单用gemini 4 argon测试了一下检索skill，可以下载之后让agent根据用户习惯来修改不同检索源的检索skill，以下为插件介绍：

面向**医学 / 生命科学**的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：检索 PubMed、Europe PMC、arXiv、bioRxiv、medRxiv，生成引用（Vancouver / APA / GB/T 7714 / Nature / BibTeX / RIS / CSL-JSON），并读取开放获取全文用于核对“这句话是否有文献支持”。

工具统一使用 `medical_` 前缀，与 `@shlv/dsh-literature`（dblp + arXiv 的 CS 工具）区分，两者可以共存。

插件是零运行时依赖的纯 Node ESM 模块（只用 Node 内置的 `fetch` 和 `node:fs`），不依赖 Python、Biopython 或任何 npm 包。

---

## 1. 五个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `medical_literature_search` | 多源检索 + 去重 + CSV/JSON 导出 |
| `medical_literature_get` | 单篇题录（含 volume/issue/pages、撤稿标记）+ 完整摘要 |
| `medical_literature_cite` | 题录 → 格式化引用 / `.bib` / `.ris` / CSL-JSON |
| `medical_literature_fulltext` | 开放获取全文 → 章节索引 + 有界正文 + Markdown 落盘 |
| `medical_literature_check` | 句子 → 最相关段落；参考文献表 → 重复/撤稿告警 |

### `medical_literature_search`

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | 共享检索词。自由文本按源自动适配（arXiv 去停用词） |
| `queries` | object | **推荐。** 每个源一条原生 query，值原样发送；键即源名 |
| `sources` | string[] | 默认 `["pubmed","europepmc","arxiv","biorxiv"]`；可选 `medrxiv` |
| `max_results` | integer | **融合后**最终返回条数，1–100，默认 10 |
| `candidates` | integer | 每个源的召回窗口，1–100，默认 `max(20, 3×max_results)`；预期论文排在源内靠后时调大 |
| `fusion` | string | `rrf`（默认，只用各源自己的排名做倒数排名融合）/ `source`（按源分块）/ `bm25`（本地词频重排，显式要求才用） |
| `year_from` / `year_to` | integer | 出版年闭区间 |
| `sort` | `"relevance"` / `"date"` / `"cited"` | 默认 `relevance`；`date` 按日期倒序；`cited` 按 Europe PMC 被引次数倒序，**只能单源 `sources:["europepmc"]`** |
| `abstract_chars` | integer | 摘要截断长度，默认 600；0 = 不显示 |
| `save_path` | string | `.csv` / `.json` / `.jsonl`；相对路径按会话工作目录解析 |

**排序策略**：默认信任各引擎自己的排序——PubMed 的 Best Match 已经综合了 MeSH、字段权重、时间等信号，Europe PMC 和 arXiv 也一样。插件只做 **RRF（倒数排名融合）**：每个源的第 1 名得 `1/61`、第 2 名 `1/62`……跨源相加，**不重新按词频打分**。只有显式写 `fusion: "bm25"` 才会用本地 BM25 覆盖源排序（它不知道 MeSH/引用量/时间，通常更差）。想扩大召回就调大 `candidates` / `max_results`，而不是重排。

**经典 vs 前沿**：被引次数和时间是相反的信号。`sort: "cited"` 只走 Europe PMC 的 `CITED desc`，记录会带 `cited_by_count`；PubMed 没有引文排序。需要两者兼顾时分两次查——第一轨 Europe PMC `sort:"cited"` 捞 PROSEVA、CAPP2 这类奠基文献，第二轨 PubMed `sort:"date"`/`relevance` 捞最新试验，由模型分别呈现，不要混成一个分数。引文排序也偏袒老旧、宽泛的论文，查询里要先加设计过滤器或主题约束。

**为什么要分源写 query**：PubMed 认 `[tiab]` / `[MeSH Terms]`，Europe PMC 认 `TITLE_ABS:` / `MESH:` / `SRC:PPR`，arXiv 认 `ti:` / `abs:` / `cat:`。同一字符串发给三个引擎，轻则精度暴跌，重则 0 结果。插件会在发请求前拦截跨引擎语法并报错。完整语法见 [skills/medical-literature/SKILL.md](skills/medical-literature/SKILL.md)。

```json
{
  "queries": {
    "pubmed": "(CRISPR[tiab] OR \"Gene Editing\"[MeSH Terms]) AND 2024:2026[dp]",
    "europepmc": "TITLE_ABS:CRISPR AND MESH:\"Gene Editing\" AND PUB_YEAR:[2024 TO 2026]",
    "arxiv": "(abs:CRISPR OR abs:\"gene editing\") AND submittedDate:[202401010000 TO 202612312359]",
    "biorxiv": "TITLE_ABS:CRISPR AND TITLE_ABS:\"base editing\""
  },
  "max_results": 20,
  "save_path": "crispr_preprints.csv"
}
```

**召回技巧**：arXiv 用词干/通配符 `abs:patholog*`、`abs:histopatholog*`、`abs:prognos*`，否则 `pathology` 匹配不到 `pathological`；`totals` 远大于返回数时（如 `arxiv 5/444`），目标方法可能排在 42 位，需按名查或调大 `max_results`。

**已知系统名**（如 PathAgent、NOVA、SPARK）不要当概念查：`agent` 匹配不到 `agentic` 或 `PathAgent` 这个 token，SPARK/NOVA 还是会撞上普通词。直接 `ti:PathAgent OR ti:NOVA OR ti:SPARK`，并注意预印本在 arXiv、正式版在 PubMed/Europe PMC。

单个源失败不会让整个调用失败：错误进 `errors`，其余源照常返回；只有所有源都失败才抛错。

### `medical_literature_cite`

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `identifier` | 一条 DOI / PMID / PMCID / arXiv ID |
| `identifiers` | 多条（最多 50），生成一个参考文献列表 |
| `output` | `vancouver`（默认）、`apa`、`gb-t-7714`、`nature`、`bibtex`、`ris`、`csl-json` |
| `save_path` | 可选；`.bib` / `.ris` / `.json` 自动选择对应格式；显式 `output` 与扩展名冲突会报错 |

```jsonc
// 润色时插入一条引用
{ "identifier": "10.3390/cells13100800", "output": "vancouver" }

// 整理整份参考文献，导出给 Zotero
{ "identifiers": ["10.3390/cells13100800", "PMID:32939066", "arXiv:1706.03762"],
  "output": "bibtex", "save_path": "refs.bib" }
```

输出示例：

```text
# Vancouver
Laurent M, Geoffroy M, Pavani G, Guiraud S. CRISPR-Based Gene Therapies: From Preclinical to
Clinical Treatments. Cells. 2024;13(10):800. doi:10.3390/cells13100800

# APA 7
Laurent, M., Geoffroy, M., Pavani, G., & Guiraud, S. (2024). CRISPR-Based Gene Therapies: From
Preclinical to Clinical Treatments. Cells, 13(10), 800. https://doi.org/10.3390/cells13100800
```

- 元数据来自 PubMed / Europe PMC / Crossref，工具不会编造作者或年份。
- 模板是标准样式的近似实现，投稿前请按目标期刊的具体规则复核。
- 预印本使用 `@misc`（BibTeX）、`TY  - UNPB`（RIS）、`[EB/OL]`（GB/T）。

### `medical_literature_fulltext`

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `identifier` | DOI / PMID / PMCID / arXiv ID / URL |
| `section` | 可选，按章节标题过滤（如 `"methods"`） |
| `max_chars` | 返回给模型的正文上限，默认 12000 |
| `save` | 是否保存完整 Markdown，默认 `true` |
| `save_path` | 可选；默认 `literature/<id>/fulltext.md` |

```jsonc
{ "identifier": "PMID: 38786024", "section": "discussion", "max_chars": 8000 }
```

| 来源 | 全文途径 | 实测 |
|---|---|---|
| PMC / Europe PMC OA（有 PMCID） | `rest/{PMCID}/fullTextXML`（JATS） | ✅ 章节 + 参考文献完整 |
| arXiv | `arxiv.org/html/{id}` | ✅ 有 HTML 的论文 |
| bioRxiv / medRxiv | 无可靠途径 | ❌ PDF 端点 Cloudflare 429 |
| 付费墙期刊 | 无 | 只有摘要 |

**关于 403**：`europepmc.org/articles/...?pdf=render` 返回 Cloudflare 人机校验页，`pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/.../pdf/` 返回 reCAPTCHA 页，bioRxiv 返回 `429 error code: 1015`——这些是下载端点的反爬，不是付费墙，也不是代码问题。插件改用 **Europe PMC REST 的 JATS XML** 和 **arXiv HTML**，完全绕开 PDF 端点。

### `medical_literature_check`

用于润色时的两件事：**找支持句子的段落**，以及**审校一组参考文献**。

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `claim` | 要核对的句子；省略则只做参考文献审计 |
| `identifier` / `identifiers` | 1–10 条 DOI / PMID / PMCID / arXiv ID |
| `top_k` | 每个来源返回几段，默认 3 |
| `deep` | 是否读取 OA 全文，默认 `true`；`false` 只用摘要、更快 |

```jsonc
// 这句话是否有文献支持？
{ "claim": "CRISPR-based therapy has been approved for sickle cell disease",
  "identifiers": ["PMID: 38786024"], "top_k": 3 }

// 参考文献表是否有重复 / 撤稿？
{ "identifiers": ["PMID: 38786024", "10.3390/cells13100800"], "deep": false }
```

输出每段的 `coverage`（句子关键词命中比例）、`score`（BM25）和所在章节；同时给出：

- **重复**：同一 DOI / 标题对应多条引用
- **撤稿**：题录带 `retracted` 时警告
- **极性差异**：句子含否定词而最相关段落不含（或反之）时提示人工核对
- **弱匹配**：最高 coverage 低于阈值时提示“可能不支持”

**必须明确的限制**：这是**词面检索**（BM25 + 关键词覆盖），不是语义蕴含判断。它能可靠地把范围缩到几段，是否真的支持结论仍要读原文。实测中：

- “CRISPR 疗法已获批用于镰状细胞病” → 第一段直接命中摘要里 FDA 批准 Casgevy 的那句（coverage 0.71）
- “碱基编辑不产生双链断裂” → 正确句在 top 3 内，但缩写 DSB 导致 Cas9 段落排第一，同时触发极性警告
- “碱基编辑治愈所有实体瘤” → 无支持段落，触发 partial-match 警告

---

## 2. 安装到 DSH profile

插件按 DSH bundle 规范打包：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 插入 `medical-literature` 行。

### 从 npm 安装（推荐）

包已发布到 npm：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-medical-literature>

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-plugin-medical-literature
```

### 从本地源码安装（开发用）

```bash
# 先把 PLUGIN 指向本仓库（任意位置）
PLUGIN=/path/to/dsh-medical-literature-plugin
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add link:$PLUGIN
```

把包名加入 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-plugin-medical-literature"]
    }
  }
}
```

profile 默认开启配置热重载：改 `cordis.patch.yml` 或重新 `pnpm add` 可触发重组。**新增或修改工具 schema 时，已运行的 `dsh web` 仍缓存旧定义，需要新开会话或重启服务**；只改 skill 文本则下一次读取即可生效。

### 安装检索/引用 skill

从 npm 安装时：

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills
ln -sfn ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-plugin-medical-literature/skills/medical-literature \
        ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature
```

从本地源码安装时：

```bash
PLUGIN=/path/to/dsh-medical-literature-plugin
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills
ln -sfn $PLUGIN/skills/medical-literature ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature
```

skill provider 会监听根目录，创建后无需重启即可出现在会话的 skill 目录里。

Skill 自带一个 PICO 拆解模板（人群/干预/对照/结局/研究类型 → MeSH + 自由词 + `[pt]` 过滤器）和一个 MeSH 映射脚本：

```bash
node ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature/scripts/mesh-map.mjs "chronic kidney disease"
# → PubMed 实际翻译："renal insufficiency, chronic"[MeSH Terms]
# → descriptor D051436，条目词 Chronic Kidney Diseases / Chronic Renal Insufficiency ...
```

它还能提前暴露缩写歧义：`MACE` 会被 PubMed 映射成 *Myristica*（肉豆蔻），`ATTR` 映射成 TTR 蛋白。

卸载：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm remove dsh-plugin-medical-literature
# 从 dsh.profile.bundles 删除包名
rm ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature
```

---

## 3. 数据源与限速

| 源 | 接口 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| PubMed | E-utilities `esearch` + `efetch`（MEDLINE） | 题录、摘要、MeSH、DOI、卷期页码、PMC |
| Europe PMC | REST `search` + `{PMCID}/fullTextXML` | 覆盖 MEDLINE/PMC/预印本；O

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 项目名 Toast 通知插件，内置温暖、可选择的手机风格提示音包。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bing

[![CI](https://github.com/lsl1931/dsh-bing/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/lsl1931/dsh-bing/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-5b8cff)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)

> English: Windows toast notifications for DSH that name the project, with a warm, selectable phone-style sound pack.

给 DSH 桌面端的**带项目名 Windows 通知**：会话结束、出错或停下来等你时 **bing** 你一下。内置一套柔和、接近手机系统提示音的合成音效，可在插件详情页里逐个试听和切换。

当前版本 **0.2.1**，已在 DSH 桌面端 0.2.1-rc.2 / Windows 11 上实装。

## 为什么再做一个

参考插件 dsh-notify-desktop 的接缝选得很对，但两件事不顺手：

1. 通知只说了“任务完成”，没说是哪个项目、哪次会话；
2. 电子短音太生硬；这一版换成温和的铃、木琴、卡林巴、水滴，带一点房间混响。

这个仓库同时保留原插件已经验证过的东西：窗口有焦点不打扰、点通知回前台、切回窗口立刻停声、服务级提问也能提醒。

## 特性

- 标题：**项目名 · 已完成** / 出错了 / 等你确认 / 还在等你
- 正文：真实会话标题 + 本轮摘要
- 项目名解析：重命名过的工作区标题 → cwd 最后一段 → 真实会话标题 → DSH
- 音效：8 个柔和合成音（0.8–1.9 秒），四类场景（完成 / 出错 / 等待 / 催办）各选一个，每个都能试听
- 入口：侧边栏 **插件 → dsh-bing 详情页** 的配置区，不占用设置页
- 自定义：导入自己的 wav/mp3/…；复制到本机用户目录，原文件移走也不影响
- 点通知把窗口拉回前台；宿主 Toast 的点击回包只有 `dsh://open`，所以不跳转会话

## 内置音效

| 名称 | 文件 | 场景 | 时长 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 极光 | sounds/01-aurora.wav | 完成（默认） | 1.8s |
| 木琴 | sounds/02-marimba.wav | 完成 | 1.3s |
| 卡林巴 | sounds/03-kalimba.wav | 完成 | 1.1s |
| 玻璃 | sounds/04-glass.wav | 等待（默认） | 1.5s |
| 气泡 | sounds/05-bubble.wav | 等待 | 0.8s |
| 低音 | sounds/06-low.wav | 出错（默认） | 1.0s |
| 回声 | sounds/07-descend.wav | 出错 | 1.3s |
| 花开 | sounds/08-bloom.wav | 催办（默认） | 1.9s |

全部由 scripts/generate-sounds.mjs 合成，44.1kHz / 单声道 / 16-bit PCM，按 RMS 校准响度。
可以直接双击 `sounds/*.wav` 试听，也可以在插件详情页里点 ▶。

**关于苹果/华为原声**：它们的系统音效有版权，仓库不直接打包。这 8 个是按“软起音、木质/玻璃/铃、带一点空间感”的听感重新合成的。
如果你本机有正版音效文件，插件详情页的「添加音效…」可以直接导入；文件只复制到本机用户目录，不会上传。

## 环境

- Windows 10 / 11
- DSH 桌面端 0.2.x（profile `desktop`）
- 普通用户不需要 Node；仓库里的 `lib/` 已经构建好

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装（DSH CLI 会把参数转给 pnpm）：

    & "<DSH 桌面端安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "github:lsl1931/dsh-bing"

本地开发时用链接安装（路径换成你的 clone）：

    & "<DSH 桌面端安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "link:<绝对路径>\dsh-bing"

装完**完全退出并重启** DSH 桌面端。不要和 dsh-notify-desktop 同时启用，否则同一轮会弹两条通知。

所有数据都在本机：偏好存渲染层 localStorage，导入的音效复制到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-bing\custom`，不上传任何内容。

## 配置

侧边栏打开 **插件**，进入 **dsh-bing** 详情页。配置区在描述和组件列表之间，
包含总开关、提示音、五类结束状态、三类等待确认、四类音效选择 + 试听、催办分钟数、测试通知、自定义音效导入/删除/缓存清理。

这是 plugin-manager 给组合包自带配置的官方 slot（`plugins.bundle.config`，key `dsh-bing`），不需要修改 harness。

## 开发

零运行时依赖；宿主是纯 ESM，客户端是 CJS 模块由 `build.mjs` 打成一个 bundle。

    npm run sounds         # 重新生成 8 个音效
    npm run sounds:check   # 校验已提交的音效（含逐字节可复现）
    npm test               # node:test（36 个用例）
    npm run build          # 生成 lib/index.js、lib/shared/*、lib/client.js
    npm run check          # 音效校验 + 单测 + 构建

Node >= 22。改完源码后重新 `npm run build` 并重启 DSH。

## 已知限制

- 仅 Windows；Toast 与 System.Media.SoundPlayer 都是 Windows 路径。
- 点通知只回前台，不跳会话。
- 顶层插件列表卡片不显示配置；配置在 dsh-bing 的详情页。
- 苹果/华为原始系统音效有版权，仓库只提供风格接近的合成音；自定义导入走本机目录。

## 目录

    src/index.js          宿主半：projection + 13 条路由 + Toast/音频
    src/shared/           schema、projection、音效库与 WAV 缓存
    src/client/           watcher、文案、设置、React 配置面板
    sounds/catalog.json   内置音效的单一事实来源
    scripts/              合成与 WAV 工具
    lib/                  构建产物（提交，profile 直接链接）
    PLAN.md               实现规划与设计决策

## 参考与许可

实现思路参考了 [paleech0/dsh-notify-desktop](https://github.com/paleech0/dsh-notify-desktop)（MIT）公开的行为与接缝说明；代码为本仓库独立实现。

音效文件由本仓库脚本生成，随本仓库以 MIT 发布。许可证见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

# dsh-papercut

**Papercut explainer films, end to end — natively on Windows, no WSL.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that turns one sentence of
idea into a finished vertical (9:16) cut-paper explainer: script → local text-to-speech →
word-level timed captions → Remotion render → QA contact sheets.

```
$ dsh --profile papercut
> 做一个关于剪纸的 25 秒短片
   → papercut_plan → papercut_voice → papercut_storyboard → papercut_render → papercut_qa
   → episodes/01-jianzhi/papercut/out/jianzhi-papercut.mp4   (1080×1920, 27.5 s, −14.7 LUFS)
```

![demo](docs/demo/jianzhi-loop.gif)

## Why this exists

The upstream [papercut-explainer](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/papercut-explainer) library is a
beautiful Remotion kit, but its toolchain is 27 bash and Python scripts written for macOS
(Apple `rsync`, `mlx-whisper`, Homebrew `ffmpeg`, `readlink -f`). Everything that touches the
OS has been rewritten here in Node, so the whole pipeline runs on a stock Windows machine:

| Piece | Upstream | Here |
|---|---|---|
| Choreography | `render.py` + `render.sh` | `src/node/render.js` — one bundle, per-scene ProRes HQ segments, content-keyed cache |
| Audio mix | `mix.py` (numpy) | ffmpeg `sidechaincompress` + `alimiter` + `loudnorm` |
| Voice | `narrate.py` (qwen-tts) | local IndexTTS-2.5 bridge over HTTP |
| Word timing | `asr.py` (mlx-whisper) | `openai-whisper` + forced alignment against the known script (`py/align.py`) |
| Chromium | system Chrome | the Edge that ships with Windows |
| ffmpeg/ffprobe | `brew install` | bundled static binaries from npm |

No WSL. No Homebrew. No `ffmpeg` on `PATH`. Python is only needed for two leaf scripts
(forced alignment, CJK font subsetting), and the plugin calls the interpreter you point it at.

## The six tools

| Tool | Arguments | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `papercut_list` | — | Existing episodes, their duration, scene count and whether a render exists |
| `papercut_plan` | `idea`, `slug?`, `comp?`, `lines?` | Scaffolds the episode and returns the 7-line script brief |
| `papercut_storyboard` | `slug` | Camera / cut / SFX table derived from the real frame plan |
| `papercut_voice` | `slug`, `engine?`, `force?`, `model?`, `keepWarm?` | Local TTS per line, silence trim, forced word alignment, `voiceover.wav` + captions + plan |
| `papercut_render` | `slug`, `force?`, `workers?`, `conc?` | Segmented Remotion render, then one x264 pass with the audio bed |
| `papercut_qa` | `slug`, `every?`, `scale?` | Contact sheets every N frames, numbered, for visual review |

Everything else — composing scenes, writing the hook, choosing assets — is the agent's job,
guided by nine skills.

## The nine skills

Installed into `<DSH_HOME>/skills` by `npm run skills`, so DSH picks them up live:

`papercut-explainer` (router / end-to-end) · `papercut-strategy` · `papercut-hook` ·
`papercut-script` · `papercut-storyboard` · `papercut-build` · `papercut-voice` ·
`papercut-qa` · `papercut-setup` (toolchain doctor for this machine).

Say "make a papercut reel about X" and the router takes it from there.

## Install

```powershell
# 1. the plugin
dsh plugin --profile papercut add "link:D:/path/to/dsh-papercut"
#    or, from npm:  dsh plugin --profile papercut add dsh-papercut

# 2. the skills (idempotent)
cd D:/path/to/dsh-papercut
node scripts/install-skills.mjs

# 3. check the toolchain
#    in DSH: "check my papercut install"   -> runs the papercut-setup doctor
```

## What the workspace must look like

`dsh-papercut` drives a *workspace* directory holding the upstream library and the render app.
The plugin finds it by walking up from its own package folder (and then from the current working
directory) looking for `app/node_modules` + `src/papercut-explainer-main/library`, so a linked
checkout and an npm-installed copy both work without configuration. Point it elsewhere with
`root` in `cordis.patch.yml`, or the `PAPERCUT_ROOT` env var.

```
<root>/
  app/                          Remotion project (node_modules with remotion, ffmpeg-static, ...)
  src/papercut-explainer-main/  the upstream MIT library (kit, audio engine, scenes template)
  episodes/<slug>/              one folder per film
  tools/                        the Node CLI used during development
```

Use `papercut-setup` (or `node tools/bin/papercut.mjs list`) to see what is missing.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11** with Edge (any modern Edge has the headless Chromium Remotion needs)
- **Node 22+**
- A Python 3.11 virtualenv with `openai-whisper` + `fonttools` — only for the aligner and
  the CJK font subsetter. Point at it with `python:` in the plugin config.
- **Optional**: a local TTS HTTP bridge on `127.0.0.1:7865` (IndexTTS-2.5). The plugin probes
  `/health` and tells you how to start it; it never spawns the model itself, because that would
  hold VRAM hostage.

## Configuration

`cordis.patch.yml` in this package:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: papercut
      name: dsh-papercut
      config:
        root: ''                 # workspace path, else PAPERCUT_ROOT, else the built-in default
        ttsUrl: http://127.0.0.1:7865
        python: D:/tts/index-tts/.venv/Scripts/python.exe
        chromePath: C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe
        defaultModel: small      # whisper model for forced alignment
        debug: false
```

## Verified numbers

First film, `episodes/01-jianzhi` (1080×1920, 30 fps, 824 frames):

| | |
|---|---|
| Voice + alignment | 7 lines, 24.1 s of speech, ~4 s synth + ~3.3 s align per line |
| Render (cold) | 55 s — bundle 2 s, 824 frames in 3 parallel workers, final encode 9 s |
| Render (one scene changed) | 20 s — cache hits on the other six segments |
| Output | H.264 High, yuv420p, bt709, 8.6 Mbps, −14.7 LUFS, −1.0 dBTP, 0 decode errors |

## License

MIT. The bundled story kit comes from
[papercut-explainer](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/papercut-explainer) (MIT), also credited in
`NOTICE`.

plugins.description: qq-bridge 扩展：本地 GPT-SoVITS 动态语音 + B 站视频摘要（附 DSH 端口自愈）
plugins.readme_text:
# qq-bridge-addons

给 [Derpyu520/qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge) 加两个能力：

1. **动态语音**——用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把任意短句合成成语音，发成 QQ 语音条（不再限于语音库里那几条固定台词）
2. **B 站视频摘要**——给它一个 BV 号/链接，它能读到标题、数据、字幕和关键帧图片，然后像群友一样聊这个视频

同时附带一个解决「DSH 端口每次启动都变」的小工具，避免桥接静默失联。

> 本仓库只包含**扩展**，不含 qq-bridge 本体。请先自行安装上游：<https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge>。
> 上游为 MIT，署名见 [NOTICE-upstream-LICENSE.txt](NOTICE-upstream-LICENSE.txt)。

## 装了什么

| 文件 | 位置（装完后） | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp/mcp-voice-tts.js` | `<bridge>/src/` | MCP 工具 `qq_say_voice(text, target?)`：文字 → GPT-SoVITS(9880) → 桥接发语音 |
| `mcp/mcp-bili-digest.js` | `<bridge>/src/` | MCP 工具 `bili_video_digest(url, frames?)`：B 站视频摘要，可带关键帧图片 |
| `tools/video-digest.mjs` | `<bridge>/` | 摘要生成器（yt-dlp + ffmpeg） |
| `tools/sync-dsh-url.mjs` | `<bridge>/` | 扫描本机端口，把 `config.json` 的 `dsh.baseUrl` 指到当前 DSH |
| `persona/小鲸鱼.example.md` | 参考 | 人格卡范例，可直接放 `<bridge>/roles/` |

## 前置条件

- 已装好并跑通 **qq-bridge**（SnowLuma + DSH 都能连上）
- **Node 22+**（桥接本来就需要）
- 语音功能额外需要：**GPT-SoVITS API** 在 `127.0.0.1:9880` 跑着
- 视频摘要额外需要：**yt-dlp**（`C:\yt-dlp\yt-dlp.exe` 或 PATH）、**ffmpeg**

## 安装

```sh
# 1. 装扩展文件 + 注册 MCP
node install.mjs --bridge "C:\path\to\qq-bridge" --profile desktop

# 2. 放行工具（手动）
#    编辑 <bridge>/plugins/qq-agent-presets/qq-tool-restrict.mjs
#    在 SAFE_PREFIXES 里加：
#        'mcp__voice-tts__',
#        'mcp__bili-digest__',

# 3. 重启 DSH
```

重启后，DSH 的工具清单里会出现 `mcp__voice-tts__qq_say_voice` 和 `mcp__bili-digest__bili_video_digest`。

## 语音功能配置

需要三样环境变量（或用默认路径）：

| 变量 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `GPT_SOVITS_URL` | 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:9880` |
| `GPT_SOVITS_REF` | 参考音频路径；默认 `<bridge>/ref/reference.wav` |
| `GPT_SOVITS_REF_TEXT` | 参考音频里说的那句话（必须逐字一致，否则音色会漂） |

参考音频建议：**5～10 秒、无背景音乐、单人、口齿清楚**。用谁的声音自己决定，别用没授权的他人声音。

## 让模型真的去用

光装上工具不够——模型经常只记得「语音库」那个老工具，会说“库里没这句”。
在人格卡里把规则写死（见 `persona/小鲸鱼.example.md` 第十二、十三节）：

```
- 用户让你“用语音念某句话”时，必须用 mcp__voice-tts__qq_say_voice，参数 text 就是那句话；
  不要用 qq_send_voice 代替，也不要说“语音库里没这句”。
```

## 端口自愈

DSH 桌面版每次启动随机分配端口，桥接的 `dsh.baseUrl` 会失效且**不报错**（事件流 0 帧）。
`sync-dsh-url.mjs` 扫描本机监听端口，用 DSH 的 401 固定文案做指纹，找到就写回配置。

建议放在启动脚本里，**每次（重）启动前都跑一遍**：

```bat
:loop
"%NODE_EXE%" sync-dsh-url.mjs
"%NODE_EXE%" src/bridge.js
```

## 安全边界

- `qq_say_voice`：文本上限 80 字，只发到桥接白名单内的群/私聊，复用桥接自己的限流与审计
- `bili_video_digest`：只接受 `bilibili.com` / `b23.tv` / BV 号；只读，不执行命令
- 两个工具都不读写用户文件，也不改变桥接的发送闸门

## 已知坑

| 现象 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| 工具装好但群里调不到 | `qq-tool-restrict.mjs` 的白名单没加前缀 |
| 合成报 `cp932 codec can't encode` | 服务端控制台是日文编码，启动时设 `PYTHONUTF8=1`、`PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` |
| 抽帧报 `format is not available` | 竖屏视频高度是 852，筛选条件别用 `height<=480` |
| 桥接连不上 DSH | 端口变了，跑 `sync-dsh-url.mjs` |

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。上游 qq-bridge 的 MIT 声明见 [NOTICE-upstream-LICENSE.txt](NOTICE-upstream-LICENSE.txt)。

plugins.description: BTW side chat for DeepSeek Harness: a read-only fork of the current conversation, answered in a Codex-style right-sidebar window.
plugins.readme_text: # BTW Side Chat **Ask a side question in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) without interrupting the main task.** `/btw` forks the current conversation with its full context, answers in a read-only side chat, and opens the answer in a Codex-style right-sidebar window. [![test](https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-btw-sidechat/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-btw-sidechat/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ## Features - **Full inherited context.** DSH's session log is the source of truth, so `/btw` forks the latest completed-turn prefix of the current conversation. The child sees the parent's user messages, assistant answers, and tool results — no re-summarization step. - **Read-only by policy.** The child is pinned to native tools, then restricted to `read`, `read_image`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`, `web_fetch`, and `skill`. A monotonic per-agent guard denies every other tool, including `run_code` and any tool registered later. Deployments that register a tool on the agent scope (some delegation tools do) may still show that tool's schema; the guard denies its execution. - **A side-chat system prompt.** The child is told that it is a read-only side chat, that the inherited transcript is context rather than a task to continue, that these are its tools, and that it must answer the question directly without asking a follow-up. - **A real side window.** A `dsh-resource://btwchat/...` tab opens in the right sidebar with the normal Conversation: the inherited transcript, streaming answer, Markdown, and a composer for follow-ups. - **A compact command card.** The raw resource address is hidden behind a side-chat card with the question and an **Open** button, so the tab can be reopened later from the transcript. - **No build step, no dependencies.** Plain ESM Host code and a browser module, host theme tokens, English and Chinese UI copy. ## Install Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or a nearby version with the right sidebar, the Session Controller, and `/btw` command support. ### From GitHub 1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar. 2. Choose **Add plugin** → **Install third-party plugin**. 3. Enter the repository URL: ```text https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-btw-sidechat.git ``` A local clone path works too and keeps the checkout linked for edits. 4. Install and enable the bundle, then refresh the page once so the client half loads. Or ask a DSH agent to install the bundle from the same URL. ### Local clone ```bash git clone https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-btw-sidechat.git cd dsh-btw-sidechat npm test ``` Install the cloned directory through **Plugins → Add plugin** as above. > Only one plugin may provide the global `/btw` command. Disable any other `/btw` plugin (for example `@michengai/dsh-btw`) before enabling this one; two global commands with the same name are a load error, not a shadow. ## Usage | Action | How | | --- | --- | | Ask a side question | `/btw why does the retry test fail?` | | Read the answer | The side chat opens automatically in the right sidebar | | Follow up | Type in the side chat's composer; the same read-only child answers | | Reopen | Click **Open** on the `/btw` card in the parent transcript | | Close | Close the tab; the child session stays in the session list | The side chat is a normal forked session, so it also appears in the workspace's session list and survives a restart. Its read-only policy is re-installed when it is resumed. ### What the side chat sees The fork is cut at the latest **completed** turn. A `/btw` sent while the parent is mid-turn does not include the in-flight turn; a conversation with no completed turn returns a helpful error instead of creating an empty child. ### What "read-only" means The side chat cannot write files, run shell commands, edit code, change configuration, create goals or schedules, spawn subagents or workflows, ask blocking questions, or read other sessions. It can read workspace content and the web. Its own conversation is a separate fork, so follow-up prompts and answers never enter the parent context. ## How it works 1. The Host command calls `sessionController.fork({ sessionId })`, which creates a forked child with the parent's event prefix and preset. 2. Before the first prompt, it pins the child to native tool presentation, computes the read-only intersection from `tools.schemas(child)`, installs `tools.restrict` and a `tools.guard`, and adds a `btw:side-chat` system-prompt section. 3. It titles the child `BTW · `, which is also the durable marker used to re-adopt the policy after a cold resume. 4. It admits the question with `sessionController.prompt`, then returns a `dsh-resource://btwchat/session/?parent=…&q=…` address in the command result. 5. The Client registers a `btwchat` resource provider, a right-sidebar tab type and body, a command card keyed `btw`, and a local `command/executed` listener. The listener refreshes the session catalog, then opens the tab. 6. The tab renders the normal `conversation.content` factory in `embedded` mode inside the child's `SessionProvider`. The inherited transcript and composer are the shipped ones. More detail: [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). ## Limits - **Web/Desktop only.** The side window uses the right sidebar, so the Client half needs a DSH Web or Desktop profile. The Host half still creates the child on a TUI host, but no side window opens there. - **`command/executed` is local.** Auto-open happens in the browser tab that submitted `/btw`. In another tab, after a reload, or after a Host-side invocation, use the command card's **Open** button. - **The title is the resume marker.** Renaming a side chat removes the `BTW · ` prefix; the live process keeps the restriction, but a later cold resume of that renamed session will no longer recognize it as a side chat. - **No auto-archive.** Closing the tab leaves the forked session in the conversation list, like an ordinary fork. - **Scoped tool schemas can remain visible.** `tools.restrict` filters inherited tools; a tool registered directly on the child's agent scope (for example a delegation tool added by a preset) stays in the schema list. The guard denies its execution, and the side-chat prompt states that only the listed tools are available. - **Web tools are allowed.** `web_search` and `web_fetch` can send text to search providers. If the inherited transcript is sensitive, remove them from `READ_ONLY_TOOLS` in `index.js`. ## Development ```bash npm test ``` The tests use Node's built-in test runner and cover command parsing, title and address codecs, the read-only intersection, policy text, the fork/adopt/prompt flow, error mapping, root-versus-child tool presentation, resume adoption, and the client module shape. CI runs on every push and pull request. A live Host probe on 2026-10-20 forked a small fixture session, prompted the child with `/btw Reply with exactly: BTW PROBE OK`, and observed: - the child title `BTW · Reply with exactly: BTW PROBE OK`; - the answer `BTW PROBE OK`; - the `btw:side-chat` section in the child's assembled prompt; - `read`, `glob`, `grep`, `skill`, `read_image`, `web_search`, and `web_fetch` visible; - `bash`, `write`, `edit`, and `run_code` absent (a preset-scoped `subagent` schema remained visible but is guard-denied); - the command result address the Client parses. The live Client slot tree confirmed the right-sidebar tab body, the `btw.conversation` child slot, and the `btw` command card. The auto-open path is client-local; it was verified by registration and codec tests rather than by driving the browser. ```text index.js Host half: /btw command, fork, read-only policy, resume adoption client.js Client half: resource provider, sidebar tab, command card, auto-open cordis.patch.yml Loads the bundle row locale/ Plugin-inventory metadata (en, zh) test/ Node tests for the pure helpers and the Host flow docs/

plugins.description: Ink-wash whale-leap splash for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ink Whale Leap · 水墨鲸跃

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the web UI when the page loads, then fades out by itself.

![Ink Whale Leap](assets/launch.png)

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

## What it shows

A full-window overlay in the palette of an ink wash on paper: the whale rises out of the still water, three ink rings spread from the waterline, a few ink drops scatter upward, and the wordmark `DeepSeek Harness` settles in with a red `鲸` seal and the line `鲸跃 · 与你同游`.

- 3.95 s after the page loads the overlay fades, and it is removed from the DOM at 4.75 s.
- `Esc` dismisses it immediately.
- With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the animations are turned off.
- If the tab is hidden when the page loads, playback waits for the tab to become visible (15 s fallback).
- The overlay is decorative: `aria-hidden="true"`, `pointer-events: none`, so it never takes clicks or keyboard focus.

![Ink rings spreading from the waterline](assets/rings.png)

## Install

Once the plugin is listed in the DSH plugin market, install it from Settings → Plugins. From a command line:

```
dsh plugin add dsh-ink-whale-leap
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it adds one loader row — there is no client bundle to approve.

## Preview without installing

Open `preview.html` in a browser from a checkout of this repository; it loads `splash.js` against a blank page.

## How it works

This is a host-only plugin. It reacts to `webserver/index-inject` by pushing a single inline `<script>` row, and serves the animation source at `/ink-whale/splash.js` from the `webServer` service.

There is deliberately no client entry point: in DSH, a client bundle that fails to activate aborts the web boot, and a launch animation is not worth that risk. Every step of activation is wrapped in `try/catch`, so a missing service or a failing injection leaves the app untouched instead of breaking it.

The animation itself is one self-contained IIFE with inline CSS and SVG (`splash.js`) — no network requests, no fonts, no images.

## Configuration

None. The plugin has no settings page and no options.

## Uninstall

Remove it the same way as any other plugin (market uninstall, or `dsh plugin remove dsh-ink-whale-leap`).

## Notes

- The animation runs once per page load, on every window that loads the web UI — it is not a once-per-install welcome screen.
- It only paints over the web UI; the desktop window chrome is unaffected.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 两级搜索 failover 插件（Tavily → DeepSeek Search API；Fetch: DeepSeek → 直连）。带额度感知熔断，第一层失败自动切第二层。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-fk-search-tier

**两级搜索 + 两级抓取 failover** —— 搜索先 Tavily 后 DeepSeek Search API；抓取先 DeepSeek Fetch API 后直连兜底。

> DeepSeek Harness 插件。不改 DSH 本体，纯 `ctx.web` provider 注册。

---

## 为什么做这个

DSH 默认的 `deepseek-official` 搜索通道：

- 每次搜索**消耗一个完整模型轮次**（实测约 9.6K input token）
- 按 token 计费，高峰期成本翻倍

两级方案把成本压到最低：

```
【搜索】searchProvider: search-tier
第 1 层  Tavily   → 免 key 匿名档 / 免费 1000 credits/月
                    ↓  429 / 额度耗尽 / 5xx / 超时 / 空结果
第 2 层  DeepSeek → 5 元 / 1000 次成功请求（按次，不烧 token）

【抓取】fetchProvider: fetch-tier
第 1 层  DeepSeek Fetch API → 返回干净 Markdown（实测 ~0.3 秒）
                    ↓  429 / 额度耗尽 / 5xx / 超时
第 2 层  直连抓取           → 零成本兜底（HTML → 纯文本）
```

**实测数据**（2026-10-17）：

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| Tavily keyless 免注册 | ✅ 返回 5 条真实结果 |
| DeepSeek Fetch API | ✅ 0.53s / 931 字符（example.com） |
| DeepSeek Fetch 真实页面 | ✅ 0.27s / 24,740 字符（GitHub 仓库页） |
| 不存在的域名 | HTTP 500（API 的预期行为，触发切层） |

---

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本包路径或包名>
```

⚠️ **必须让 DSH 走 bundle 机制自动加载 patch**，不要手工把 `cordis.patch.yml`
的内容抄进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` —— 那会绕过加载时序，导致
`tool-web: waiting for web`。

装完重启 DSH。

---

## 配置

### ⚠️ 先把这件事说清楚：密钥不要写进插件目录

插件目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是**随插件发布**的文件。
把 `apiKey` 写在那里，等于把密钥公开（推 GitHub、发给别人、打包分发都会带上）。

**正确做法有两种，任选其一（推荐 A）：**

---

### A. 用环境变量（推荐）

插件会自动读这两个环境变量，`cordis.patch.yml` 里留空即可：

| 后端 | 环境变量 |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Search / Fetch | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| Tavily（可选） | `TAVILY_API_KEY` |

**Windows — PowerShell（当前用户，永久生效）：**

```powershell
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "sk-你的key", "User")
```

**Windows — 图形界面：**

```
Win + R  →  sysdm.cpl  →  高级  →  环境变量
  → 用户变量 → 新建 → 变量名 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，变量值填你的 key
  → 确定 → 重启 DSH
```

> 改完环境变量**必须重启 DSH** 才生效 —— 已在运行的进程不会重新读取。

---

### B. 在 profile 层覆盖（密钥放私有文件）

`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 是**你自己的私有文件**，不随插件发布。

在文件末尾追加：

```yaml
# 覆盖 search-tier 的配置（本文件是私有的，可以写密钥）
- id: search-tier
  name: dsh-fk-search-tier
  config:
    order: [tavily, deepseek]

    deepseek:
      apiKey: 'sk-你的key'
      baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com

    tavily:
      apiKey: 'tvly-你的key'   # 可选；没有就走 keyless 匿名档
```

**注意**：profile 层的同名 id 会**整段覆盖**插件自带的配置，
所以「想保留的键都要重述一遍」，不能只写 `apiKey`。

---

### 最小配置（零配置也能用）

**不配任何密钥**也能工作：

- **Search**：Tavily 的 keyless 匿名档（免注册，实测可用）
- **Fetch**：直连抓取（零成本兜底）

```yaml
- id: search-tier
  name: dsh-fk-search-tier
  config:
    order: [tavily, deepseek]
    tavily: {}
    deepseek: {}          # 无 key → 该层自动跳过
```

**代价**：没有 DeepSeek 层作为兜底，Tavily 匿名档限流时就没有第二层了。

---

### 完整配置项

```yaml
- id: search-tier
  name: dsh-fk-search-tier
  config:
    # ── 层级顺序 ──
    order: [tavily, deepseek]              # 搜索：先 Tavily，再 DeepSeek
    fetchOrder: [deepseek-fetch, direct]   # 抓取：先 DeepSeek Fetch，再直连

    # ── 第 1 层：Tavily ──
    tavily:
      # apiKey 留空 → keyless 匿名档；有 key 走账户额度（1000 credits/月）
      depth: basic          # basic=1 credit | advanced=2 credits
      maxResults: 8

    # ── DeepSeek 官方 API（Search + Fetch）──
    deepseek:
      # apiKey 留空 → 自动读环境变量 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY；仍然没有 → 该层跳过
      baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
      maxResults: 8
      needContent: false     # true 会额外返回网页正文（更慢、更长）
      fetchMaxBytes: 200000  # Fetch 单页最大字节

    # ── 直连抓取（零成本兜底）──
    direct:
      # userAgent: ''        # 可覆盖默认 UA
      {}

    # ── 超时 ──
    timeoutMs: 20000         # 搜索单层超时
    fetchTimeoutMs: 30000    # 抓取单层超时（页面通常更大）
    failOnEmpty: true        # 上一层返回 0 条也切下一层

    # ── 熔断 ──
    breaker:
      threshold: 3           # 瞬时故障累计几次才开断
      burstWindowMs: 300000  # 5 分钟窗口
      cooldownMs: 60000      # 瞬时故障冷却 60 秒
      quotaCooldownMs: 3600000  # 额度耗尽冷却 1 小时
```

---

### 怎么确认密钥读到了

配好并重启 DSH 后，让 AI 调一次诊断工具：

```
search_tier_status
```

返回的 `layers` 里看 `hasKey` 字段：

```json
{
  "id": "deepseek",
  "hasKey": true,        ← true 表示密钥读到了
  "needsKey": true,
  "open": false
}
```

**`hasKey: false` 说明密钥没读到**，按上面 A / B 检查，并确认已重启 DSH。

---

### 排查清单

| 现象 | 原因 | 解决 |
|---|---|---|
| `hasKey: false` | 环境变量没设，或设了没重启 DSH | 重设 + 重启 |
| `hasKey: true` 但报 401 | key 无效或已过期 | 去平台确认 |
| 一直用 Tavily，从不切 DeepSeek | Tavily 正常时不会切（这是设计） | 正常现象 |
| 两层都失败 | 网络问题 / 两边都额度耗尽 | 看错误信息里的 `skipped-open` |

---

## 切换规则

搜索与抓取共用同一套熔断语义（两个独立实例，参数相同）。

| 触发条件 | 行为 | 冷却 |
|---|---|---|
| `429` / `402` / 文本含 `insufficient` `quota` | 该层开断，立即切下一层 | **1 小时** |
| `401` / `403`（凭据问题） | 跳过该层（不冷却，配置改了立刻恢复） | 无 |
| `5xx` / 超时 / 网络错误 | 窗口内累计 3 次才开断 | **60 秒** |
| 返回 **0 条结果**（仅搜索） | 本次直接切下一层（不计入熔断） | 无 |
| 该层缺 key（仅 deepseek / deepseek-fetch） | 直接跳过 | 无 |

冷却到期后**自动半开**：下一次请求放行做探活，成功即闭合。

---

## 返回给模型的内容

### 搜索

严格遵循 DSH 的 `ctx.web` 契约，**只返回 `sources`**（让模型自己读）：

```js
{
  sources: [
    { url, title, snippet, publishedAt? }
  ],
  truncated: boolean,
  content?: string     // 仅 Tavily 返回 answer 时才带
}
```

- **Tavily**：`snippet` 取 `content` 前 500 字符
- **DeepSeek**：`snippet` 优先取 `summary`（600-800 字符长摘要），回退 `snippet`（100-200 字符）

模型收到的最终文本由 DSH 的 `formatSearchOutput` 组装成 markdown 来源列表。

### 抓取

按官方 `WebFetchResult` 契约：

```js
{
  url: string,              // 请求的 URL（API 不报告重定向后的最终 URL）
  statusCode: 200,          // 成功即 200（DeepSeek API 不报告目标页面状态）
  body: { kind: 'text', content: string },
  truncated: false
}
```

- **DeepSeek Fetch**：直接用 API 返回的 `content`（已是 Markdown）
- **直连抓取**：`fetch` 原始 HTML → `htmlToText()` 转纯文本；非 HTML 原样返回

---

## 诊断

注册了一个只读工具 `search_tier_status`，AI 可直接调用查看：

```json
{
  "search": {
    "providerId": "search-tier",
    "order": ["tavily", "deepseek"],
    "lastWinner": "tavily",
    "layers": [
      { "id": "tavily", "hasKey": false, "open": false, "lastError": null },
      { "id": "deepseek", "hasKey": true, "open": false, "lastError": null }
    ],
    "breaker": { "tavily": { "open": false, "remainingMs": 0 } }
  },
  "fetch": {
    "providerId": "fetch-tier",
    "order": ["deepseek-fetch", "direct"],
    "lastWinner": "deepseek-fetch",
    "layers": [
      { "id": "deepseek-fetch", "hasKey": true, "open": false, "lastError": null },
      { "id": "direct", "hasKey": true, "open": false, "lastError": null }
    ]
  }
}
```

---

## 自测

```sh
node test/selftest.mjs
```

**53 项断言**，覆盖：

| 段 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 一 | 错误分类 `classify()` |
| 二 | 熔断器（额度 / 瞬时 / 半开） |
| 三 | 搜索 provider 契约 |
| 四 | **真实** Tavily keyless 调用 |
| 五 | 降级逻辑（熔断跳过） |
| 六 | 空结果切层 |
| 七 | **Fetch provider 契约与 failover**（13 项） |
| 八 | **真实** DeepSeek Fetch API 调用（5 项） |

---

## 与 dsh-search-failover 的区别

| | `dsh-search-failover` | **本插件** |
|---|---|---|
| 搜索后端数 | 10 个 | **2 个（专注）** |
| 抓取 failover | ❌ | ✅ **有（2 层）** |
| 支持 DeepSeek 新 Search API | ❌ 无 | ✅ **有** |
| 支持 DeepSeek Fetch API | ❌ 无 | ✅ **有** |
| Tavily keyless | ✅ | ✅ |
| 熔断 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 设置页 | ✅ | ❌（纯配置） |
| 代码量 | ~90 KB | **~26 KB** |

如果你的需求就是「Tavily → DeepSeek」两级搜索加重试兜底抓取，本插件更轻。

---

## 与官方 `dsh-web-deepseek-api` 的区别

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起官方内置了 DeepSeek Search / Fetch provider。两者不冲突，但定位不同：

| | 官方内置 | **本插件** |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek Search | ✅ | ✅ |
| DeepSeek Fetch | ✅ | ✅ |
| **两级 failover** | ❌ **无**（README 明确写「不会自动重试或回退至其他提供者」） | ✅ **有** |
| **Tavily 免费额度兜底** | ❌ 无 | ✅ 1000 次/月 |
| **消费 `summary` 长摘要** | ❌ 丢弃（只映射 `snippet`） | ✅ 优先使用 |
| 热切换 provider | ✅（rc.2 的 Volatile） | ❌ 需重启 |
| 维护方 | 官方 | 自己 |

⚠️ **两者同时存在时可能触发 `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`**（多个可用 provider 但未显式指定）。
本插件的 patch 显式写了 `searchProvider` / `fetchProvider`，所以不会歧义；
但如果你在设置页把官方开关打开，要注意读一下最终生效的是哪个。

---

## 已知限制

1. **Tavily keyless 是匿名档**，有速率限制，随时可能被官方关闭
2. **DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 均按次计费**，各 5 元/1000 次
3. **直连抓取层不解析 JS 渲染的页面**（纯 `fetch` + HTML 转文本）
4. **抓取成功一律报 200** —— DeepSeek API 不报告目标页面状态，这是官方契约的行为
5. 无设置页，改配置需编辑 YAML 并重启

---


## 更新记录

### v0.2.0（2026-10-20）

**密钥不再随插件发布 —— 修掉一个会泄露 API Key 的安全问题**

插件目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是随插件分发的文件。之前把 `apiKey` 写在那里，
等于把密钥公开（推 GitHub、发给别人、打包分发都会带上）。

- `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `apiKey` 一律留空
- 插件新增环境变量支持：`DEEPSEEK_API_

plugins.description: wraps microsoft/playwright-cli
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-playwright-cli

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-playwright-cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-playwright-cli)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-playwright-cli)](LICENSE)

Drive a real browser from **DeepSeek Harness**: one tool, `playwright_cli`, wraps
[`microsoft/playwright-cli`](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli), plus a bundled
`playwright-cli` skill that teaches the model the command vocabulary.

playwright-cli itself recommends *CLI + skills* over MCP for coding agents: commands are short, and
the page snapshot goes to a file instead of a giant tool schema or accessibility tree. This plugin
keeps that design and only adds the two missing pieces — a tool the model can call, and a skill that
is discovered and loaded on demand.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

## Install

**In the app:** **Plugins → Plugin Manager → install bundle → `dsh-playwright-cli`**.

**From a shell**, when the Harness CLI is on your PATH:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-playwright-cli
```

**From an agent:** `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`, `target: dsh-playwright-cli`.

> PATH collisions are common on Windows (`dsh` may belong to another product). If `dsh plugin` is not
> the Harness CLI, use the in-app Plugin Manager.

`playwright-cli` must be available on the machine:

```bash
npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest
```

And a browser has to exist — playwright-cli ships none. Either download its Chromium once:

```bash
playwright-cli install-browser chrome-for-testing
```

or reuse a browser that is already installed, which needs no download at all:

```text
playwright_cli  open https://example.com --browser=msedge
```

## Quick start

```text
playwright_cli  open https://playwright.dev --browser=msedge
playwright_cli  snapshot --depth=4
   → [artifacts] C:\...\.playwright-cli\page-....yml   (read this file to get refs)
playwright_cli  click e15
playwright_cli  fill e7 "user@example.com"
playwright_cli  screenshot --filename=shot.png
playwright_cli  close
```

Every result carries the page status, the artifacts it produced (absolute paths), and the CLI's exit
code. `--raw` returns just the value, e.g. `--raw eval "document.title"`.

## Tool parameters

| Parameter | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | yes | One playwright-cli command without the `playwright-cli` prefix. Quote arguments containing spaces. |
| `session` | no | Named browser session (`-s=<name>`), for isolating parallel tasks. |
| `workdir` | no | Working directory; artifacts land in `<workdir>/.playwright-cli/`. Defaults to the session directory. |
| `timeoutMs` | no | Per-call wall clock limit (default from config, capped at 900000). |

## Configuration

Every field is optional and lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `playwright-cli` row:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `executable` | auto-discovered | Absolute path to `playwright-cli.js` (run with `nodePath`) or to a real executable |
| `nodePath` | `node` from PATH | Node used for the CLI *and* the browser daemon it spawns |
| `session` | none | Default session name |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-command limit |
| `disableUpdateNotifier` | `true` | Sets `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` (see the Node 24 note below) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment, e.g. `PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BROWSER: chrome` |

## How it works

- **No shell.** The command line is tokenized and passed as an argv vector to
  `node playwright-cli.js …`, so `&` in URLs, spaces in paths, `--data="k=v"` and Windows quoting
  cannot corrupt a command.
- **Discovery.** It walks up from the session directory looking for a local
  `node_modules/@playwright/cli` or `node_modules/playwright`, then checks the usual global npm,
  pnpm and Homebrew locations. `executable` overrides all of it.
- **Real Node, not the Host binary.** The desktop Host runs as Electron-as-node
  (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`), so `process.execPath` is the app binary. playwright-cli re-spawns its
  browser daemon with that path and dies with `too many arguments`; the plugin therefore resolves a
  real `node` from PATH first.
- **Exit codes are honest.** playwright-cli's update notifier crashes the process *after* a successful
  command on Node 24 (exit code becomes `0xC0000409`); the notifier is disabled by default.
- **Artifacts are files.** Snapshots, screenshots, PDFs, videos, traces and console logs are resolved
  to absolute paths and listed under `[artifacts]`, so the model reads them with `read` / `read_image`
  instead of paying for them in the result.
- **Hints, not guesses.** The two first-run failures (no browser installed, browser not started) get
  an extra `[hint]` line with the exact next command.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playwright-cli is not installed or was not found` | no local/global install | `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`, or set `executable` |
| `Browser "chrome-for-testing" is not installed` | no bundled browser | `playwright_cli install-browser chrome-for-testing`, or `--browser=msedge` |
| `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found` | Chrome not in its default path | `--browser=msedge` or `--browser=chrome` |
| `too many arguments. Expected 1 argument but got 2` | CLI launched with the Electron binary | leave `nodePath` unset so the plugin resolves `node` |
| `The browser '<name>' is not open` | session idle-closed or never opened | `open` again (add `--persistent` to keep the profile) |
| `百度安全验证` page on Baidu | site-level anti-automation captcha | not a plugin bug: report the wall, try another engine |
| snapshot only has header/footer | results rendered after the command returned | re-run `snapshot`, or use `find "<text>"` |

## Maintaining this plugin

### Repository layout

| Path | Owns | Update it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Tool schema, spawn, discovery, artifacts, hints, presenters | CLI flags/output shape change, or DSH's `ToolDefinition` changes |
| `skill.js` | Model-facing skill text (command table, loop, triage) | the command surface changes |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row + default config + field comments | you add a config key |
| `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, description, icon | wording/branding |
| `README.md`, `README.zh.md` | user + maintainer docs | any behavior change |

### Adapting to a new playwright-cli release

1. `npm view @playwright/cli version`, then `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`.
2. `playwright-cli --help` — compare the command list with the table in `skill.js`. The skill *is* the
   model's contract, so keep it in sync before anything else.
3. Check `open` / `attach` flags (`--browser`, `--device`, `--persistent`, `--profile`, `--config`).
   New flags normally need docs only, no code.
4. Check the output markers: `### Page`, `### Snapshot`, `[Snapshot](.playwright-cli/…)`, `### Events`
   with `console-….log#L1-L6`. If a path shape changes, adjust `MARKDOWN_LINK`, `FILE_TOKEN` and the
   `#L…` stripping in `collectArtifacts()`.
5. Check session selection: the plugin passes `-s=<name>` **and** sets `PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_SESSION`. If a
   release starts rejecting one of them, drop the env assignment in `execute()`.
6. Check the error strings matched by `hintFor()`: `is not installed`,
   `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found`, `is not open, please run open first`.
7. Run the smoke test below, then bump the version and the changelog.

### The output schema is enforced

DSH validates the tool's returned value against `output.schema`; a mismatch fails the whole call with
`returned invalid output`. Declare every nullable field as
`oneOf: [{type:'string'}, {type:'null'}]` (this bit us once with `signal: null`), and build the
returned object and the schema together.

### Adapting to a new DSH release

1. `dsh --version`; only raise `engines.dsh` when you depend on something new.
2. Re-check the four services the plugin uses. In a live session: `cordis_inspect_query` with
   `platform: host`, `provider: Service`, `input: {"service":"tools"}` (also `subprocess`, `skills`,
   `workingDirectory`).
3. Confirm `ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable('node')` s

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 side-chat plugin: a docked right-Sidebar chat tab with shared session context, selection-marked questions, streaming replies and a Ctrl+J shortcut
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidechat

面向 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1** Web GUI 的侧边聊天插件。

侧边聊天以**右侧栏停靠标签页**的形式存在，与「工作区文件 / 新建终端 / 浏览器」共用同一个入口：
只有主动打开时才出现，不悬浮、不遮挡主对话。它会自动共享**当前会话的对话内容**；在主对话中
用鼠标**划选**一段内容后，可一键将其作为引用带入并直接提问。

- 目标运行时：**DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**（Desktop / Web）
- 安装方式：DSH 插件管理器一键导入，Git 地址 `github:JiaskyNo1/dsh-sidechat`
- 开源协议：MIT

## 安装（一键导入）

本仓库是可直接导入的 bundle 包：`lib/` 已包含构建产物，安装器会自动完成依赖安装、
bundle 选择与配置注册，**无需构建、无需手动改配置**。

1. 打开 DSH 侧边栏 → **插件（Plugins）** → **添加插件**。
2. 在 Git 地址栏粘贴：

   ```
   github:JiaskyNo1/dsh-sidechat
   ```

3. 安装完成后启用插件。当前页面通常会热加载；若未出现，重启 DSH 即可。

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 右侧栏停靠 | 注册为右侧栏标签类型（`kind: sidechat`），与内置的文件 / 终端 / 浏览器标签并列 |
| 快捷键 | `Ctrl+J`（Desktop）/ `Ctrl+Alt+J`（Web）打开；指南卡片与快捷键参考显示按键提示 |
| 会话上下文 | 自动注入当前会话最近 40 条消息（含工具调用与结果，按字符预算截断）、项目根目录、Git 分支与工作区 AGENTS.md 指令 |
| 与主对话一致 | 使用与主对话相同的模型与推理等级、路由默认采样参数；思考过程采用主界面的「思考 / 已思考」折叠样式 |
| 划选引用 | 划选主对话文本后点击「添加到侧边聊天」，引用以草稿形式插入输入框；补充问题并发送后才回答 |
| 回答质量 | 不覆盖 temperature/maxTokens，沿用路由默认值；上下文包含主对话的工具调用与结果，便于给出有依据的回答 |
| 流式输出 | 逐字流式显示，可中途停止 |
| 思考过程 | 可折叠的「💭 思考过程」块 |
| Markdown | 标题、代码块、列表、引用、链接、表格 |
| 模型选择 | 标签页内切换模型与推理等级 |
| 会话隔离 | 每个会话维护独立的侧边聊天历史 |
| 清空 | 二次确认后清空当前会话的侧边聊天 |

## 工作原理

```
浏览器 (lib/client.js)
├── ctx.remote.$mount(TYPERT_REMOTE)          挂载 sidechat Remote
├── ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ kind })   注册侧边栏标签类型
├── sidebar.right.pane.tab (key: dsh-sidechat) 停靠标签页正文
├── ctx.shortcuts.register('sidechat.open')   Ctrl+J / Ctrl+Alt+J
└── shell.overlay                              划选时出现的「添加到侧边聊天」按钮
        │
        │ Typert Remote（JSON over /api）
        ▼
宿主 (lib/index.js)
└── SidechatService
    ├── getContext(sessionId)  项目根 / Git 分支 / 会话最近 12 条消息
    ├── models()               provider / model / reasoning effort 目录
    ├── start(messages)        调用 llm.stream 生成，返回 job id
    ├── poll(jobId)            返回累计文本、思考过程、完成状态与错误
    └── stop(jobId)            停止任务
```

设计要点：

- 宿主半运行时只依赖 `zod`；`@deepseek-ai/*` 均为类型导入，安装后无需解析对等依赖。
- 浏览器半只使用 Web 平台共享模块表中的 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime` / `zod`。
- 宿主 `./typert` 导出为手写 strict manifest，由 `dsh-typert-loader` 自动发现并注册。
- 标签页正文注册在 session-scoped 的 `sidebar.right.pane.tab`，每个会话自动获得独立实例。

## 使用

| 操作 | 方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 打开 | 右侧栏「打开右侧边栏」→ 指南页「侧边聊天」卡片；或按 `Ctrl+J`（Web 为 `Ctrl+Alt+J`） |
| 关闭 | 标签页上的 ✕ |
| 划选引用 | 选中主对话文字 → 点击「添加到侧边聊天」→ 引用草稿插入输入框 → 补充问题后按 Enter / 点击「发送」 |
| 切换模型 | 标签页底部下拉框选择模型与推理等级 |
| 停止生成 | 生成中点击「停止」 |
| 清空 | 标签页头部「清空」，二次确认 |

侧边聊天是独立问答面：不写入主会话，也不会调用工具。

- 本面板没有工具；若模型尝试输出工具调用标记，会被过滤并按需重试，不会把原始标记显示出来。

## 构建与开发

需要 Node.js 24 与安装好依赖的 DSH 0.2.1 运行时（`@deepseek-ai/*` 包）。

```bash
pnpm install                       # 安装开发依赖
pnpm run typecheck                 # tsc --noEmit
pnpm run build                     # tsc 中间产物 + tsdown 构建
```

构建产物：

| 文件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半（ESM） |
| `lib/typert.js` | 宿主 strict Typert manifest |
| `lib/types.js` | wire 类型模块（运行时为空） |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器 bundle，`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 包装，CSS Modules 内联 |

构建中间产物（`lib/types/`、`lib/*.map`）已被 `.gitignore` 排除，不进入仓库。

## 兼容性

- 目标版本：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**。
- 使用的 client 契约：`client-modules` 的 bundle 格式、`ui-sidebar-right` 标签注册、
  `ui-slots` keyed slot、`client-shortcuts` 命令注册、`typert` Remote 协议。
- 跨 DSH 版本升级时，需要同步调整 `package.json` 的 peerDependencies 与 `tsdown.config.ts`
  中的平台共享模块表。

## 项目结构

```
.
├── cordis.patch.yml        # bundle 补丁：声明本包
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts            # 宿主半：SidechatService
│   ├── typert.ts           # 宿主 strict Typert manifest
│   ├── types.ts            # wire 类型
│   └── client/
│       ├── index.ts        # 浏览器半入口
│       ├── apply.tsx       # 标签类型 / 标签正文 / 快捷键 / 划选按钮 / Markdown
│       ├── remote.ts       # 浏览器侧 Remote contribution
│       ├── settings.ts     # 偏好存储（localStorage）
│       └── sidechat.module.css
├── lib/                    # 预构建产物（安装即用）
├── tsconfig.json
└── tsdown.config.ts
```

## 更新记录

版本变化与升级说明见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 致谢与许可

- 上游实现：[kittsai/dsh-sidechat](https://github.com/kittsai/dsh-sidechat)（MIT）。
- 本项目同样以 **MIT** 发布，详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；版权声明与上游保持一致。
